name: corvallis_winter_weather
description: Compare Corvallis, Oregon winter 2024-25 daily PRCP, TMIN and TMAX from NOAA GHCN with the 10-year average for the same days, and plot one three-panel figure.

nodes.name: download_ghcn_daily
nodes.description: Entry step (no input files). Download daily NOAA GHCN weather data for the Corvallis, Oregon station (GHCN-Daily station USC00351862, CORVALLIS STATE UNIV; station id overridable via params['station']) from NOAA NCEI's public, no-credential GHCN-Daily per-station access CSV (https://www.ncei.noaa.gov/data/global-historical-climatology-network-daily/access/<station>.csv; wide format with DATE and per-element value and <ELEMENT>_ATTRIBUTES columns, values in GHCN units). Keep only dates 2014-12-01 through 2025-02-28, which covers winter 2024-25 (Dec 2024 - Feb 2025) and the preceding 10 winters (Dec 2014 - Feb 2015 through Dec 2023 - Feb 2024) needed for the 10-year average. Convert units: PRCP tenths of mm -> mm, TMIN/TMAX tenths of degC -> degC. Treat a value as missing when blank or when its quality flag (second field of the _ATTRIBUTES column) is non-blank. Write one file per variable, numbered by rank: rank 1 = PRCP, rank 2 = TMIN, rank 3 = TMAX, i.e. ghcn_daily_1.csv, ghcn_daily_2.csv, ghcn_daily_3.csv, each with columns date (YYYY-MM-DD), variable, value, units, one row per date in the window (value blank if missing). Use retries with a timeout on the HTTP request and raise a clear error if the download fails, the station has none of the three variables, or the window has no rows.

outputs.name: ghcn_daily_{rank}.csv
outputs.description: Daily values for one variable, 2014-12-01..2025-02-28 (rank 1 PRCP mm, rank 2 TMIN degC, rank 3 TMAX degC); the step writes all three copies.

nodes.code:
"""Download NOAA GHCN-Daily data for one station and write one CSV per variable.

Source: NOAA NCEI GHCN-Daily per-station access CSV (public, no credentials).
Output i (rank order) holds variable VARIABLES[i]: PRCP (mm), TMIN (degC), TMAX (degC).
"""
import io
import time

import pandas as pd
import requests

DEFAULT_STATION = "USC00351862"  # CORVALLIS STATE UNIV, Oregon
BASE_URL = "https://www.ncei.noaa.gov/data/global-historical-climatology-network-daily/access/{station}.csv"
WINDOW_START = "2014-12-01"
WINDOW_END = "2025-02-28"

# rank order: rank 1 = PRCP, rank 2 = TMIN, rank 3 = TMAX
VARIABLES = ["PRCP", "TMIN", "TMAX"]
UNITS = {"PRCP": "mm", "TMIN": "degC", "TMAX": "degC"}
SCALE = {"PRCP": 0.1, "TMIN": 0.1, "TMAX": 0.1}  # GHCN tenths -> mm / degC

TIMEOUT = 120
RETRIES = 4


def _download(url: str) -> str:
    last_err = None
    for attempt in range(1, RETRIES + 1):
        try:
            print(f"Downloading {url} (attempt {attempt}/{RETRIES})")
            resp = requests.get(url, timeout=TIMEOUT)
            resp.raise_for_status()
            if not resp.text.strip():
                raise RuntimeError(f"Empty response from {url}")
            return resp.text
        except (requests.RequestException, RuntimeError) as err:
            last_err = err
            print(f"Download attempt {attempt} failed: {err}")
            if attempt < RETRIES:
                time.sleep(5 * attempt)
    raise RuntimeError(f"Failed to download GHCN-Daily data from {url} after {RETRIES} attempts: {last_err}")


def _quality_flag(attr) -> str:
    """Return the quality flag (second comma-separated field) of a GHCN _ATTRIBUTES value."""
    if attr is None or (isinstance(attr, float) and pd.isna(attr)):
        return ""
    parts = str(attr).split(",")
    return parts[1].strip() if len(parts) > 1 else ""


def main(inputs: dict, outputs: dict, params: dict) -> None:
    station = (params or {}).get("station", DEFAULT_STATION)
    out_paths = outputs["output1"]
    if isinstance(out_paths, str):
        out_paths = [out_paths]
    n = len(out_paths)
    if n == 0:
        raise ValueError("outputs['output1'] holds no paths")
    if n > len(VARIABLES):
        raise ValueError(f"outputs['output1'] has {n} paths but only {len(VARIABLES)} variables are defined: {VARIABLES}")

    url = BASE_URL.format(station=station)
    text = _download(url)
    df = pd.read_csv(io.StringIO(text), dtype=str, keep_default_na=False, low_memory=False)
    if "DATE" not in df.columns:
        raise RuntimeError(f"Downloaded file for station {station} has no DATE column; columns: {list(df.columns)[:10]}")

    present = [v for v in VARIABLES if v in df.columns]
    if not present:
        raise RuntimeError(f"Station {station} has none of the variables {VARIABLES}")
    print(f"Station {station}: {len(df)} rows total; variables present: {present}")

    df["DATE"] = pd.to_datetime(df["DATE"], format="%Y-%m-%d")
    df = df[(df["DATE"] >= WINDOW_START) & (df["DATE"] <= WINDOW_END)]
    if df.empty:
        raise RuntimeError(f"Station {station} has no rows between {WINDOW_START} and {WINDOW_END}")
    if df["DATE"].duplicated().any():
        raise RuntimeError(f"Station {station} has duplicate dates in the window")
    df = df.set_index("DATE")
    full_index = pd.date_range(WINDOW_START, WINDOW_END, freq="D")

    for i, path in enumerate(out_paths):
        var = VARIABLES[i]
        if var in df.columns:
            raw = pd.to_numeric(df[var].str.strip().replace("", pd.NA), errors="coerce")
            attr_col = f"{var}_ATTRIBUTES"
            if attr_col in df.columns:
                qflag = df[attr_col].map(_quality_flag)
                raw = raw.where(qflag == "")
                n_flagged = int((qflag != "").sum())
            else:
                n_flagged = 0
            values = (raw * SCALE[var]).round(1)
        else:
            print(f"WARNING: station {station} has no {var} column; all values blank")
            values = pd.Series(dtype=float)
            n_flagged = 0
        values = values.reindex(full_index)

        out = pd.DataFrame({
            "date": full_index.strftime("%Y-%m-%d"),
            "variable": var,
            "value": values.values,
            "units": UNITS[var],
        })
        out.to_csv(path, index=False)
        print(f"Wrote {var} ({UNITS[var]}): {len(out)} rows, {int(out['value'].notna().sum())} valid, "
              f"{n_flagged} quality-flagged -> {path}")

nodes.name: compare_winter_variable
nodes.description: Ranked step (3 parallel instances). params['rank'] selects the variable: rank 1 = PRCP, rank 2 = TMIN, rank 3 = TMAX. Reads its own variable's daily file (ghcn_daily_{rank}.csv). Compare winter 2024-25 (Dec 2024 - Feb 2025) daily values with the 10-year average for the same days: the 10-year average for each calendar day (month-day, Dec 1 .. Feb 28) is the arithmetic mean over the 10 preceding winters (2014-15 .. 2023-24) of that day's value, skipping missing days and recording how many years contributed (n_years); the average is blank when fewer than 5 years have a value. Feb 29 values are dropped (winter 2024-25 has no Feb 29). Write winter_comparison_{rank}.csv with one row per winter day ordered 2024-12-01 .. 2025-02-28 (90 rows) and columns: date, day_of_winter (1..90), variable, units, value_2024_25 (blank if missing), avg_10yr, n_years, diff (value_2024_25 minus avg_10yr, blank if either is missing). Raise if the input has no data for the variable.

outputs.name: winter_comparison_{rank}.csv
outputs.description: Day-by-day winter 2024-25 vs 10-year average for this instance's variable.

nodes.code:
"""Compare winter 2024-25 daily values of one GHCN variable with the 10-year average.

Ranked step: rank 1 = PRCP, rank 2 = TMIN, rank 3 = TMAX.
The 10-year average for each calendar day (Dec 1 .. Feb 28) is the mean over the
10 preceding winters (2014-15 .. 2023-24), skipping missing days; blank when fewer
than 5 years have a value. Feb 29 is dropped.
"""
import pandas as pd

VARIABLES = ["PRCP", "TMIN", "TMAX"]  # rank order
TARGET_WINTER = 2024  # winter starting Dec 2024
N_BASE_YEARS = 10
MIN_YEARS = 5


def _winter_start_year(dates: pd.Series) -> pd.Series:
    """Dec belongs to the winter starting that year; Jan/Feb to the winter starting the year before."""
    return dates.dt.year.where(dates.dt.month == 12, dates.dt.year - 1)


def main(inputs: dict, outputs: dict, params: dict) -> None:
    rank = int(params["rank"])
    if not 1 <= rank <= len(VARIABLES):
        raise ValueError(f"rank {rank} out of range 1..{len(VARIABLES)}")
    var = VARIABLES[rank - 1]
    in_path = inputs["input1"]
    out_path = outputs["output1"]
    print(f"Rank {rank}/{params.get('max_rank')}: variable {var}, input {in_path}")

    df = pd.read_csv(in_path)
    required = {"date", "variable", "value", "units"}
    missing_cols = required - set(df.columns)
    if missing_cols:
        raise ValueError(f"Input {in_path} lacks columns {sorted(missing_cols)}; has {list(df.columns)}")

    file_vars = set(df["variable"].dropna().astype(str).unique())
    if file_vars != {var}:
        raise ValueError(f"Input {in_path} holds variables {sorted(file_vars)}, expected only {var} for rank {rank}")
    units_vals = df["units"].dropna().astype(str).unique()
    if len(units_vals) != 1:
        raise ValueError(f"Input {in_path} has units {list(units_vals)}, expected exactly one")
    units = units_vals[0]

    df["date"] = pd.to_datetime(df["date"], format="%Y-%m-%d")
    df["value"] = pd.to_numeric(df["value"], errors="coerce")
    if df["date"].duplicated().any():
        raise ValueError(f"Input {in_path} has duplicate dates")
    if df["value"].notna().sum() == 0:
        raise ValueError(f"Input {in_path} has no data for {var}")

    # Winter days only, Feb 29 dropped
    winter = df[df["date"].dt.month.isin([12, 1, 2])].copy()
    winter = winter[~((winter["date"].dt.month == 2) & (winter["date"].dt.day == 29))]
    winter["wyear"] = _winter_start_year(winter["date"])
    winter["md"] = winter["date"].dt.strftime("%m-%d")

    # Target winter 2024-25 calendar
    target_dates = pd.date_range(f"{TARGET_WINTER}-12-01", f"{TARGET_WINTER + 1}-02-28", freq="D")
    target_dates = target_dates[~((target_dates.month == 2) & (target_dates.day == 29))]
    md_order = target_dates.strftime("%m-%d")

    cur = winter[winter["wyear"] == TARGET_WINTER].set_index("md")["value"]
    if cur.notna().sum() == 0:
        raise ValueError(f"Input {in_path} has no {var} data for winter {TARGET_WINTER}-{(TARGET_WINTER + 1) % 100:02d}")

    base_years = range(TARGET_WINTER - N_BASE_YEARS, TARGET_WINTER)
    base = winter[winter["wyear"].isin(base_years)]
    if base["value"].notna().sum() == 0:
        raise ValueError(f"Input {in_path} has no {var} data for the baseline winters "
                         f"{base_years[0]}-{base_years[-1] + 1}")
    grp = base.groupby("md")["value"]
    mean = grp.mean()  # skips NaN
    n_years = grp.count()

    value = cur.reindex(md_order)
    n = n_years.reindex(md_order).fillna(0).astype(int)
    avg = mean.reindex(md_order).where(n >= MIN_YEARS).round(2)
    diff = (value - avg).round(2)

    out = pd.DataFrame({
        "date": target_dates.strftime("%Y-%m-%d"),
        "day_of_winter": range(1, len(target_dates) + 1),
        "variable": var,
        "units": units,
        "value_2024_25": value.values,
        "avg_10yr": avg.values,
        "n_years": n.values,
        "diff": diff.values,
    })
    if len(out) != 90:
        raise RuntimeError(f"Expected 90 winter days, built {len(out)}")
    out.to_csv(out_path, index=False)
    print(f"Wrote {var} ({units}): {len(out)} rows, {int(out['value_2024_25'].notna().sum())} with 2024-25 values, "
          f"{int(out['avg_10yr'].notna().sum())} with 10-yr avg, n_years range "
          f"{int(out['n_years'].min())}-{int(out['n_years'].max())} -> {out_path}")

nodes.name: plot_winter_comparison
nodes.description: Fan-in step that runs once after all three ranked comparison instances finish. Reads the fixed list of the three per-variable comparison tables winter_comparison_1.csv (PRCP), winter_comparison_2.csv (TMIN), winter_comparison_3.csv (TMAX); raise if any is missing. Make one figure with three panels (one per variable: PRCP, TMIN, TMAX) showing winter 2024-25 vs the 10-year average: three panels stacked vertically with a shared date x-axis (Dec 2024 - Feb 2025); PRCP panel shows winter 2024-25 daily values as bars and the 10-year average as a line; TMIN and TMAX panels show both as lines; each panel has a legend, a y-axis label with units (mm for PRCP, degC for TMIN/TMAX) and a title naming the variable. Overall title: 'Corvallis, OR (GHCN USC00351862): winter 2024-25 vs 10-year average (2014-15 to 2023-24)'. Save as winter_comparison.png at 150 dpi using the headless matplotlib backend (Agg).

outputs.name: winter_comparison.png
outputs.description: One figure, three panels (PRCP, TMIN, TMAX).

nodes.code:
"""Plot winter 2024-25 vs the 10-year average for PRCP, TMIN and TMAX in one 3-panel figure.

Fan-in step: reads the per-variable comparison tables written by compare_winter_variable
(columns date, day_of_winter, variable, units, value_2024_25, avg_10yr, n_years, diff).
"""
import os

import matplotlib

matplotlib.use("Agg")
import matplotlib.dates as mdates  # noqa: E402
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt  # noqa: E402
import pandas as pd  # noqa: E402

PANEL_ORDER = ["PRCP", "TMIN", "TMAX"]
PANEL_NAMES = {
    "PRCP": "Precipitation (PRCP)",
    "TMIN": "Minimum temperature (TMIN)",
    "TMAX": "Maximum temperature (TMAX)",
}
EXPECTED_UNITS = {"PRCP": "mm", "TMIN": "degC", "TMAX": "degC"}
SUPTITLE = ("Corvallis, OR (GHCN USC00351862): winter 2024-25 vs 10-year average "
            "(2014-15 to 2023-24)")
REQUIRED_COLS = {"date", "variable", "units", "value_2024_25", "avg_10yr"}


def _load(path: str) -> pd.DataFrame:
    if not os.path.isfile(path) or os.path.getsize(path) == 0:
        raise FileNotFoundError(f"Comparison table missing or empty: {path}")
    df = pd.read_csv(path)
    missing = REQUIRED_COLS - set(df.columns)
    if missing:
        raise ValueError(f"{path} lacks columns {sorted(missing)}; has {list(df.columns)}")
    vars_ = df["variable"].dropna().astype(str).unique()
    if len(vars_) != 1:
        raise ValueError(f"{path} holds variables {list(vars_)}, expected exactly one")
    units = df["units"].dropna().astype(str).unique()
    if len(units) != 1:
        raise ValueError(f"{path} has units {list(units)}, expected exactly one")
    df["date"] = pd.to_datetime(df["date"], format="%Y-%m-%d")
    df["value_2024_25"] = pd.to_numeric(df["value_2024_25"], errors="coerce")
    df["avg_10yr"] = pd.to_numeric(df["avg_10yr"], errors="coerce")
    return df.sort_values("date").reset_index(drop=True)


def main(inputs: dict, outputs: dict, params: dict) -> None:
    paths = inputs["input1"]
    if isinstance(paths, str):
        paths = [paths]
    if not paths:
        raise ValueError("input1 (winter_comparison tables) holds no files")
    out_path = outputs["output1"]

    tables = {}
    for p in paths:
        df = _load(p)
        var = str(df["variable"].iloc[0])
        if var in tables:
            raise ValueError(f"Variable {var} appears in more than one input ({p})")
        tables[var] = df
        print(f"Read {var}: {len(df)} rows, {int(df['value_2024_25'].notna().sum())} values, "
              f"{int(df['avg_10yr'].notna().sum())} averages <- {p}")

    missing = [v for v in PANEL_ORDER if v not in tables]
    if missing:
        raise ValueError(f"input1 lacks comparison tables for {missing}; found {sorted(tables)}")
    extra = [v for v in tables if v not in PANEL_ORDER]
    if extra:
        raise ValueError(f"input1 holds unexpected variables {extra}")

    fig, axes = plt.subplots(3, 1, figsize=(11, 10), sharex=True)
    for ax, var in zip(axes, PANEL_ORDER):
        df = tables[var]
        units = str(df["units"].iloc[0])
        if units != EXPECTED_UNITS[var]:
            raise ValueError(f"{var} units are {units!r}, expected {EXPECTED_UNITS[var]!r}")
        if var == "PRCP":
            ax.bar(df["date"], df["value_2024_25"], width=0.8, color="tab:blue",
                   alpha=0.7, label="Winter 2024-25")
            ax.plot(df["date"], df["avg_10yr"], color="black", linewidth=1.5,
                    label="10-year average")
        else:
            color = "tab:blue" if var == "TMIN" else "tab:red"
            ax.plot(df["date"], df["value_2024_25"], color=color, linewidth=1.5,
                    label="Winter 2024-25")
            ax.plot(df["date"], df["avg_10yr"], color="black", linewidth=1.5,
                    linestyle="--", label="10-year average")
        ax.set_ylabel(f"{var} ({units})")
        ax.set_title(PANEL_NAMES[var])
        ax.legend(loc="upper right")
        ax.grid(True, alpha=0.3)

    axes[-1].set_xlabel("Date")
    axes[-1].xaxis.set_major_locator(mdates.MonthLocator())
    axes[-1].xaxis.set_minor_locator(mdates.DayLocator(bymonthday=[8, 15, 22]))
    axes[-1].xaxis.set_major_formatter(mdates.DateFormatter("%b %Y"))
    first = min(t["date"].min() for t in tables.values())
    last = max(t["date"].max() for t in tables.values())
    axes[-1].set_xlim(first - pd.Timedelta(days=1), last + pd.Timedelta(days=1))

    fig.suptitle(SUPTITLE, fontsize=12)
    fig.tight_layout(rect=(0, 0, 1, 0.97))
    fig.savefig(out_path, dpi=150)
    plt.close(fig)
    print(f"Wrote figure -> {out_path}")

assumptions: "the Corvallis, Oregon station" -> GHCN-Daily station USC00351862 (CORVALLIS STATE UNIV)
"10-year average" -> the 10 winters before 2024-25: Dec 2014-Feb 2015 through Dec 2023-Feb 2024
"for the same days" -> matched by calendar day (month-day), Dec 1 .. Feb 28; Feb 29 dropped
average -> arithmetic mean over the years with a value; blank if fewer than 5 of 10 years have data
missing or flagged data -> values with a non-blank GHCN quality flag are treated as missing
units -> PRCP tenths of mm converted to mm; TMIN/TMAX tenths of degC converted to degC
presentation_assumptions: data source -> NOAA NCEI GHCN-Daily per-station access CSV (public, no credentials)
panel layout -> three panels stacked vertically (PRCP, TMIN, TMAX), shared date x-axis
plot style -> PRCP 2024-25 as bars with the average as a line; temperatures as two lines
files -> per-variable CSVs numbered by rank (1 PRCP, 2 TMIN, 3 TMAX); figure winter_comparison.png at 150 dpi
